links.outcome: Pharmacist-reported barriers to AI integration, including insufficient AI training
links.effect: 75.3% (n = 70) of pharmacists reported insufficient AI training as a barrier, tied with challenges in addressing patients' emotional well-being.
links.quote: The most commonly reported barriers were challenges in addressing patients' emotional well-being and insufficient AI training, both noted by 75.3% (n = 70) of pharmacists.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey evaluating hospital pharmacists' attitudes, willingness, and perceived barriers toward AI integration in pharmacy practice.
